title: Add truncation indicator for long clipboard content
line: The clipboard pop-up now shows every line of an entry and marks how many characters or lines are left out.
explanation: The clipboard delegate cut every entry at 100 characters and let Qt wrap the result into three rows, so text was dropped with no sign, and one long line pushed the following lines out of view (the reporter's last line vanished). Tomáš's open MR !7121 raises the limit to 150 characters per line, gives each line of a multi-line entry its own row, and appends the number of hidden characters (+N) per line and hidden lines (+N lines) in the highlight colour. On top of the MR, the hidden-character count is now taken before the line is HTML-escaped and its leading spaces are wrapped in markup, which otherwise gave wrong or negative counts ("(+-5)") on indented lines.

commits.message:
klipper: show when an entry is cut short

Entries were silently cut at 100 characters and lines after a long one
were pushed out of view. Show up to 150 characters, give each line of a
multi-line entry its own row and mark how much of it is left out.

BUG: 506739

media.caption: Master: the long single line is cut with no sign, the indented code entry loses lines, and the reporter's git entry wraps its first line over the others.
With the fix: each line gets its own row with (+N) for hidden characters and (+N lines) for hidden lines; the reporter's three git lines are all visible.
